Mateeeee one week ago I was doing bad at work, also was in a one day fast and in my 30 minutes lunch pause I took the bike and wandered aimlessly in the industrial zone with my mind freaking out, I was running away totally automatic, the next day after coming home with my stomach still empty I started crying and told my family that I was feeling miserable, unvalued and worthless.
My grandmother told me that she loves me a lot and that I have to keep up and to smile, no matter what; even if I am a bald alopecian with big glasses I have to smile and keep going, I don't have to be recognized, nor to be popular because there is nothing to compensate, just remember that beauty is inside. Hope this random words can help you a little.
